msg: $this->emit() was removed in Livewire 3 — rename it to $this->dispatch(). The v2 call throws BadMethodCallException at runtime, not at build time.
$this->emitSelf() / emitUp() were removed in Livewire 3 — events now bubble by default; use $this->dispatch(...)->self() or plain dispatch().
$this->dispatchBrowserEvent() was removed in Livewire 3 — browser and component events are one API now: $this->dispatch().
wire:model.defer is not a modifier in Livewire 3 — plain wire:model is already deferred. The .defer suffix is ignored and the binding reads as a no-op modifier.
wire:model.lazy was renamed in Livewire 3 — the blur-driven update is now wire:model.blur.
wire:model.debounce without .live never sends a request in Livewire 3 — debounce only applies to live bindings.
The .prefetch modifier was removed in Livewire 3 — there is no replacement; delete it or drive the state with wire:click and a loading placeholder.
The livewire:load browser event was renamed in Livewire 3 — listen for livewire:init (or livewire:initialized after Alpine boots).
@livewireStyles is gone in Livewire 3 — assets are injected automatically, and the stale directive breaks the Blade compile on upgrade day.
The $queryString property is replaced in Livewire 3 by the #[Url] attribute on each property — the array is read as an ordinary property and the URL stops syncing.
Livewire 3 discovers components in App\Livewire (app/Livewire), not App\Http\Livewire — move the class or set class_namespace in config/livewire.php.
The .defer suffix on $wire.entangle() was removed in Livewire 3 — entangled values are deferred by default; use .live for the old instant behaviour.
Livewire 3 test helpers renamed assertEmitted / assertNotEmitted to assertDispatched / assertNotDispatched — the old names fail as undefined methods, so a green suite here is a suite that never ran.
A <livewire:...> tag inside a loop needs :key in Livewire 3 — without it the DOM diff reuses the wrong child component and rows swap their state.
